claude.note: Claude Code headless mode. Prompt goes on stdin. {output} = json (quiet) or stream-json (live agent activity in the terminal). Role tools -> --allowedTools; charter forbiddenPaths/forbiddenTools -> --disallowedTools. CLAUDE.md @imports profile.md + lessons.md, so the harness does not inject those twice (except in worktrees).
claude.modelsNote: CLI aliases, never pinned versions: Claude Code resolves haiku / sonnet / opus to the newest release of each family. The controller picks the tier per job (see docs/MULTI-MODEL-SETUP.md).

antigravity.note: VERIFIED on Windows 11 / Node 24 with agy 1.5.8 (2026-11-14): a full headless run passed ('agy -p <prompt>' created the scoped file, the real check passed, job COMMITTED), including a 3,049-character goal. '-p' is an alias for '--print' and needs a prompt value; '-p ""' with the prompt on stdin FAILS ('error: empty prompt'), so the prompt is passed as an argument. Windows limit: a command line is at most 32,767 characters (8,191 through cmd.exe, which .cmd shims use), so a much longer prompt passed as an argument can still fail. agy.exe is installed in ~/.gemini/bin, which the installer does not add to PATH: add that folder to PATH or doctor reports it as not installed. No auto-approve flag on purpose (agy has --dangerously-skip-permissions and --mode); scoped file edits worked without it.
antigravity.modelsNote: Exact model IDs from 'agy models' (agy 1.5.8, 2026-11-14); agy has no 'latest' aliases, so these are the one exception to the alias-only rule. fast (docs, QA, small edits) = Gemini 3.8 Flash; medium (normal coding) = Gemini 4 Argon; high (planning, architecture, retry after a failed check) = Gemini 4 Hydrogen. All three passed real runs on 2026-11-14. When Google renames a model, run 'agy models' and update these three.

codex.note: Checked with codex-cli 0.169.0 (2026-11-14): '--full-auto' no longer exists; 'exec --sandbox workspace-write' runs non-interactively and may edit files in the project only. '-' reads the prompt from stdin. Log in once with 'codex login'.
codex.modelsNote: From 'codex debug models' (codex-cli 0.169.0): gpt-6-luna is the newest listed model; tiers differ by reasoning effort (name@effort → --model name -c model_reasoning_effort=effort). This overrides the effort in ~/.codex/config.toml, which may be set high (e.g. xhigh) for every call. When OpenAI renames a model, run 'codex debug models' and update these.

claude.note: When this engine stops on its usage limit (or its daily cap), the same agent retries ONCE on the named engine, on the model of the same tier. Only if you allowed that engine (node .harness/engines.mjs). A retry never switches again, so there are no loops. Remove an entry to turn it off.

dailyLimits.note: Optional per-engine daily caps, counted by the controller from its own log (UTC day): calls, tokens (engines that report them, e.g. claude) and usd. When a cap is reached the agent is not started; claude can then continue on agy via quotaFallback. Example: "antigravity": { "calls": 80 }, "claude": { "usd": 5 }. Remove an engine here for no cap.
